# CockroachDB Python Library

Consumer guide for coding agents working in an app that depends on the
`cockroachdb` packages (which helpers to use, what not to hand-roll):
https://cockroachlabs.github.io/cockroachdb-python-library/agents/AGENTS.md

The same guide ships inside the installed base package at `cockroachdb/AGENTS.md`.
For CockroachDB database fundamentals, see https://docs.cockroachlabs.com/llms.txt
